scenes.heading: Users, in one request
scenes.sub: The v2 API replaces three calls with a single POST.

scenes.text: Creating a user used to take three separate requests.

before.label: v1: three calls
before.text: Create the account, set the profile, send the invite: three round trips.

after.label: v2: one call
after.text: POST /v2/users does all three in a single request.

scenes.source:
curl -X POST https://api.example.com/v2/users \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{
    "email": "ada@example.com",
    "profile": { "name": "Ada Lovelace" },
    "invite": true
  }'
scenes.caption: One call creates the account, profile and invite.

scenes.label: to create a user, down from three
scenes.note: POST /v2/users replaces the account, profile and invite calls.
